app.name: Huna
app.disclaimer: A self-help tool, not a substitute for professional diagnosis or treatment.
app.privacyNote: Your data stays on this device.

home.alertHint: Start here if your alarm is high right now.
home.welcomeBack: Welcome back. Choose the smallest useful step for today.

safety.question: Is there a specific immediate danger right now, or has anything changed since you last checked?

danger.title: Your safety comes first right now
danger.cannotKnow: This app cannot determine whether you are safe. If you believe danger may be present, move toward a safer location or contact someone you trust.

steps.moveAway: Move away from the location if you can.
steps.publicPlace: Go toward a public place or one you trust.

danger.noContacts: No contacts added yet. You can add them in settings.

seal.title: You checked once
seal.body: Unless something in your surroundings has changed, you do not need to check again right now.
seal.neverBlocked: The choice is always yours. This app cannot see what is happening around you.

state.question: What feels strongest right now?
state.helper: Pick the closest one. There is no wrong answer.

sequence.title: Come back to the present
sequence.tooMuch: This isn't helping, try a different one

action.question: What small thing do you want to return to now?
action.helper: You do not have to be calm to continue.

options.continueTask: Continue what I was doing for two minutes
options.staySituation: Stay in this safe situation for three more minutes
options.finishConversation: Finish a small part of the conversation
options.water: Drink water and go back to work

done.title: You completed the exercise and chose your next action.
done.body: Go back to your life now. You do not need to stay here.

followUp.title: One quick question
followUp.body: How are things after your last session?
followUp.completedAction: Did you do the action you chose?

welcome.title: Huna
welcome.body: A private companion for moments when your internal alarm is too sensitive. The goal is not to become calm, but to return to your life sooner.

breathing.question: Does focusing on your breath help, or make things worse?
breathing.note: If you choose 'makes things worse', every breathing step will be replaced with a tactile or movement step throughout the app.

contacts.title: People you trust
contacts.helper: Their numbers appear on the safety screen. Stored on this device only and never sent anywhere.

country.question: Which country are you in?
country.helper: So the right emergency numbers appear. We will not show an unverified number.

metrics.question: Do you want to see numbers and statistics?
metrics.note: If tracking numbers makes you monitor your body more, hide them. You can change this any time, and nothing is deleted.

discreet.question: Do you often use this in public?
discreet.note: Discreet mode makes the interface look like an ordinary timer, with no colours or illustrations.

reducedMotion.question: Reduce motion
reducedMotion.note: Taken from your device settings. You can change it.

boundary.title: Before we start
boundary.body: Huna is a self-help tool. It does not diagnose, does not treat, and cannot know whether you are in danger. If symptoms persist or affect your sleep, work or relationships, seek an assessment from a qualified professional.

program.title: Four weeks, one small step a day

today.title: Today's routine
today.recoveryMinutes: Time to return after a wave

tools.title: Tools for practice, not for emergencies
tools.helper: Use them in a calm moment so your body knows them before you need them.
tools.breathingHidden: The breathing tool is hidden based on your answer at setup. You can show it again in settings.
tools.breathingHelper: Light, comfortable breaths, with the out-breath slightly longer and no holding.
tools.breathingCaution: If you feel lightheaded, return to normal breathing right away. If focusing on your breath bothers you, use the senses exercise instead.
tools.groundingHelper: Notice what is already around you. Keep your eyes open throughout.
tools.groundingDoneTitle: You came back to the present
tools.groundingDoneBody: You do not have to feel completely calm. It is enough that your attention moved from predicting to what is happening now.

senseHints.see: A colour, a shape, the light, a piece of furniture.
senseHints.touch: Your feet on the floor, your back against the chair.
senseHints.hear: Something near or far, even if it is quiet.
senseHints.smell: Coffee, air, soap, or nothing in particular.
senseHints.taste: Water, mint, or imagine a familiar taste.

tools.relaxationHelper: A gentle squeeze, then a longer release. Skip any painful area.
tools.relaxationDone: You finished the round. Notice the difference between tension and release.
tools.relaxationCaution: Do not tense an injured or painful area. The squeeze is gentle, not maximum effort.

journal.title: Trigger log
journal.helper: One situation a day is enough. This log is not an investigation.
journal.prediction: What did your mind predict would happen?
journal.evidenceDanger: What evidence of real danger exists right now?
journal.evidenceAlarm: What suggests this may be a false alarm?
journal.response: What did you do, and did it help?
journal.recoveryMinutes: How long until your body settled somewhat?

safetyChecks.title: Check once
safetyChecks.helper: Record that you checked, so you do not need to check again.

ladder.title: Life ladder
ladder.helper: Ordinary, safe activities you have been avoiding. Rank them 0 to 10 by expected tension.
ladder.curveNote: This is what you recorded. Sometimes tension falls, sometimes it does not. Both are useful information.
ladder.boundary: This step is for ordinary, safe daily activities only. Do not use it to revisit painful memories or to face genuinely dangerous situations.
ladder.seekSupport: If flashbacks, strong detachment, or ongoing danger are present, this step needs a professional alongside you, not an app alone.

card.title: My card
card.helper: Write it in a calm moment, to read in a hard one.

placeholders.whatHappens: For example: my alarm is high, but the alarm alone is not proof.
placeholders.whatHelps: For example: eyes open, feet on the floor, something with a clear texture.
placeholders.whatDoesNotHelp: For example: deep breathing, or scanning my body with attention.
placeholders.mySentence: For example: activation is a feeling, not proof.
placeholders.myNextAction: For example: stay two minutes and finish one task.

progress.title: A kind look
progress.helper: These numbers are rough signals. One high day does not undo a whole direction of learning.
progress.returnToLifeExplain: The share of sessions after which you completed the action you chose within ten minutes.
progress.tooEarlyExplain: It appears after five sessions with an answered follow-up, so it is not volatile.
progress.practisedThisWeek: You practised {{count}} times this week. Which tool seemed most helpful?

weeklyQuestions.title: Three questions that matter more than the chart
weeklyQuestions.one: Am I noticing the alarm earlier than before?
weeklyQuestions.two: Do I return to what I was doing faster, or with less checking?
weeklyQuestions.three: Am I choosing actions that serve my life even while tense?

progress.hidden: Numbers are hidden by your choice. Your data is saved and nothing was deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lockoutExplain: If you open the check again within this window, we will remind you that you already checked. We will never block you.
settings.importFailure: Could not read the file. Make sure it is a JSON backup exported from Huna.
settings.storageFull: Could not save: browser storage is full. Export a backup, then clear old data.
settings.storageUnavailable: Storage is unavailable in this browser. What you write now may not be saved.

boundary.title: Huna is a self-help tool, not a diagnosis or medical treatment
boundary.body: Hypervigilance can appear with anxiety, chronic stress, trauma, sleep problems or other causes. If symptoms persist or affect work, sleep and relationships, seek an assessment from a qualified mental health or medical professional.
boundary.crisis: If you are in immediate danger, or thoughts of harming yourself appear, or you cannot keep yourself safe, contact your local emergency services or someone you trust immediately, and do not stay alone.

errors.title: Something failed to render
errors.body: Your data is still saved on your device and has not been lost.
